name: Brice
source:
Aria’s uncle, as well as police officer.
He’s extremely tall, slim and disheveled, so both his appearance and rude, aggressive demeanor clash with the role that has been given to him.
He’s a bit more pleasant when mitigated by his colleague Ilse, but also seems to be hiding something from her too.
